page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6v-c8g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with an x86_64 architecture, providing 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The CPU configuration includes a 33 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 KB L1d cache. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For acceleration, the instance bundles four NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 64 GB of VRAM. There is no local storage included with this instance, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance profile. Single-core CPU performance is weak, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1103.89 and a poor single-threaded gzip compression rate of 19.1 GB/sec. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as shown by a stress-ng multi-core score of 23575.63 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 112.53 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth is average, reaching 118.4 GB/sec for large block reads and 57.05 GB/sec for large block writes.

Given the presence of four dedicated GPUs alongside average multi-core CPU capabilities, this instance is designed for GPU-accelerated workloads such as deep learning training, parallel computing, and scientific simulations. The lack of local storage and weak single-core performance are notable tradeoffs, positioning this instance as a specialized resource-density option where GPU compute is prioritized over raw single-threaded CPU speed or local disk I/O.
